description: The official-chat content webviews are remote origins (DeepSeek chat, Qianwen, MiniMax agent, and the conditional ChatGPT tab), so Tauri's ACL denies their invokes by default. No shell commands are wired here: the lamp that raises the management panel lives on the local strip webview (see official-chat-strip.json), so the content pages themselves stay read-only as far as the shell is concerned. The URLs are intentionally exact (not wildcards) so only those origins — not the marketing sites or any future sub-app — can drive IPC. chatgpt.com joins this list because the ChatGPT tab only appears when the local Codex login validates (usage/subscription_codex::chatgpt_web_available); forgetting it here fails as a silent ACL denial on a live webview, not as a build error.
